claim: A Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica is a cluster created from a source DB instance and receives its updates asynchronously; it can be used to migrate to a Multi-AZ DB cluster with minimal downtime.
question: What is a Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica?

values.display: created from a source DB instance
asynchronously copied to the Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica

evidence.quote: A DB cluster read replica is a special type of cluster that you create from a source DB instance. After you create a read replica, any updates made to the primary DB instance are asynchronously copied to the Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica.
This approach is ideal when you need to enhance the availability and durability of your database while minimizing downtime.

claim: You can create DB instance read replicas from a Multi-AZ DB cluster to scale reads beyond the cluster, but you cannot currently create a Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica from an existing Multi-AZ DB cluster.
question: Can a Multi-AZ DB cluster have read replicas, and of which kind?

values.display: DB instance read replicas from a Multi-AZ DB cluster
you can't create a Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica

evidence.quote: You can also create one or more DB instance read replicas from a Multi-AZ DB cluster. DB instance read replicas let you scale beyond the compute or I/O capacity of the source Multi-AZ DB cluster by directing excess read traffic to the read replicas. Currently, you can't create a Multi-AZ DB cluster read replica from an existing Multi-AZ DB cluster.
